source_conflicts: Main-text Figures 4–6/8, the solution Gtot printed in the SI, and the reconstruction from SI Esol+gas-phase Gcorr are not fully consistent. This version does not select any one set as the sole absolute numerical gold standard.

Qualitative comparisons are limited to the NN/NNS families, resting-state stabilization and fixed chiral configurations for which sources agree and actual computational support already exists. Fine substituent orderings, the sign of the Mn1-tBu oxidation reaction free energy, and the cross-family ordering of R channels are not required where the sources are not robust.
